MAIN POOL The Main Pool of 4700 m² is the largest pool of Selectum Luxury Resort Belek and is a common area for fun and relaxation at the same time. FAMILY CLUB ANA HAVUZ The Main Pool in the Family Club area is 1000 m² in size and is perfect for families. CHILDREN'S POOL The Children's Pool in the Mini Club offers an unforgettable holiday experience for the little guests. INDOOR POOL Heated The hotel features 1 indoor pool and 1 indoor children's pool. It is ideal for you to enjoy our indoor pool regardless of the weather conditions. INDOOR SEA WATER POOL Heated The indoor sea water pool with a size of 95 m² is the choice of those who want to enjoy the sea in winter. It is possible to find a pool for every need at Selectum Luxury Resort Belek. Take a moment to breathe in the fragrant Turkish pines as the panoramic bright blue of the bay welcomes your arrival. From here, everything is yours to explore. 01 03 AN UNSPOILED LANDSCAPE Stretching over 80km, the Datça Peninsula is rich with undulating hills, lush pine forests, olive groves, secluded bays and secret coves. Set in the midst of an unblemished nature reserve ringed by beaches, D Maris Bay is a theatre of natural beauty. Vivid blooms, turquoise waters and dramatic, volcanic mountains come together at the intersection of the Aegean and Mediterranean seas. WILDLIFE From the majestic feline caracal to the Eleonora falcon, we share our beautiful environment with a number of rare and precious species. Spot sea turtles as you snorkel in crystalline waters, or set sail on a motor yacht and discover Mediterranean monk seals basking in the sun. It is only a short walk away from the Hayal Lobby Bar. During your stay at the resort, you can access this private beach or take a stroll on the walking paths among lemon, kumquat, and olive trees. You can also take advantage of the private relaxation area Chalet on the beach. Customers staying in the King, Royal Suite and VIP Villa at the hotel can benefit from the Chalet, which has its own lawn area, comfortable cushions, comfortable sun loungers and electronic safe, free of charge. Other customers can make a reservation by contacting the Guest Relations Department for this privileged service that increases the comfort of their vacation for a fee. The services offered in the Chalet are as follows: Tea and coffee Lunch (snack menu) Snacks throughout the day Fresh seasonal fruits Hot and cold drinks Ice cream and lemonade Bathrobe and slippers Refrigerator Telephone Wireless Internet access Butler service all day long In addition to all these facilities, the Blue Flag beach is also home to Caretta Carettas between May and October. Caretta Caretta nests are carefully protected by Susesi Luxury Resort. This gives our guests the opportunity to safely observe the Caretta Carettas that have been living in this area for centuries. A unique vacation experience in our endless blue and refreshing pools... is waiting for you at Susesi Luxury Resort...
